author: phospheneoverdrive
description: Optional SkyrimNet WebUI agent for authoring PlayerSignals intents.json and matching wheel references. Generates JSON for the user to save; does not read or write configuration files, add actions/triggers, or control wheel dispatch. PlayerSignals is alpha; in-game acceptance of the current catalog and recipient feedback remains pending.
tagline: Intent catalog and wheel-reference authoring helper for PlayerSignals.
title: PlayerSignals Intent Helper
